classification.difficultyReason: Use the explicit angle-sum hint before the sine-rule side calculation.

inlines.text: (Hint: Angle sum of a triangle is

spec.description: Upper-left, lower-left and lower-right vertices; dark-grey outline and black labels. No angle arcs printed.
spec.mathematics: Lower-left angle 95 degrees, lower-right angle 28 degrees; upper-left to lower-right side 53.2 mm; lower-left to lower-right side x. Upper-left angle unlabelled.

answer.worked:
Angle sum of a triangle:
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^\circ-95^\circ-28^\circ\\\theta&=57^\circ\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{\sin57^\circ}&=\frac{53.2}{\sin95^\circ}\\[8pt]x&=\frac{53.2\sin57^\circ}{\sin95^\circ}\\[8pt]x&\approx44.8\text{ mm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Lower-left, upper and right vertices; dark-grey outline, black labels and no angle arcs or right-angle square.
spec.mathematics: Lower-left angle 18 degrees; upper angle 75 degrees. Lower-left to upper side x; lower-left to right side 0.53 m. Right vertex has no printed angle label.

answer.worked:
Angle sum of a triangle:
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^\circ-75^\circ-18^\circ\\\theta&=87^\circ\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{\sin87^\circ}&=\frac{0.53}{\sin75^\circ}\\[8pt]x&=\frac{0.53\sin87^\circ}{\sin75^\circ}\\[8pt]x&\approx0.5\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Left, upper and lower-right vertices; dark-grey outline, black labels, no printed angle arcs.
spec.mathematics: Left angle 78 degrees; lower-right angle 23 degrees. Upper to lower-right side 43 cm; left to lower-right side x. Upper angle unlabelled.

answer.worked:
Angle sum of a triangle:
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^\circ-78^\circ-23^\circ\\\theta&=79^\circ\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{\sin79^\circ}&=\frac{43}{\sin78^\circ}\\[8pt]x&=\frac{43\sin79^\circ}{\sin78^\circ}\\[8pt]x&\approx43.2\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
